nom: Clinique UV Solutions Brightening + Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50/PA+++

avis.texte: First, Love the matte version of this. I bought this to replace the Moisture Surge Sheertint but it does not. There isn't any color correction and it feels greasy when applied.
Left my skin extremely oily and broke out everywhere. Not worth the money.

I used Pep Start for YEARS as my sun-protecting sheer alternatige to foundation. I hoped this was the company's version of a replacement but its not. No dewy sheer finish. Its very thick and waxy. Without changing anything else in my skin routine, my skin is now dry and starting to get flaky, like it does with any mineral sunscreen. So uncomfortable. Does not look or feel good. There was nothing wrong with pep start! Just bring it back. I used it every single day - for years, religously - and never once had an unpleasant reaction. Why fix or replace something that wasn't broken?

Tinted sunscreens are a must for me in the summer and this one didn't disappoint! The Clinique tinted sunscreen gives my skin an effortless tint while providing great protection. I typically find problems with finding tints that are spf 50 and aren't too thick, but this product is a very thin consistency that absorbs right into my skin. It blends easily and has a natural finish. I always look for products that won't pill and I'm satisfied that this one doesn't. I didn't notice any strong smell but my skin will feel greasy if I don't use powder. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been reaching for this on no makeup days because it gives just enough tint to even everything out while still feeling like a lightweight sunscreen. It blends in easily, doesn't feel heavy, and leaves my skin looking healthy instead of flat. I also like that it's mineral SPF 50, so I feel protected without sacrificing how my skin looks.

The tint was a perfect match for making me look like I had the perfect tan. It went on smooth no problem blending in with my skin tone but it does leave the skin very dry so you must use a moisturizing lotion before you apply.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I've been really impressed with this sunscreen! The formula is lightweight, blends in easily, and the tint gives my skin a subtle, healthy-looking glow while helping even out my complexion. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy, layers well under makeup, and wears comfortably throughout the day. I also appreciate that it offers SPF 50, so I get great sun protection without sacrificing how my skin looks or feels. Definitely a new favorite for everyday wear!

I've been loving this Clinique tinted moisturizer with SPF 50! It gives my skin a natural, healthy-looking glow with lightweight coverage that evens everything out. It feels comfortable all day, and the SPF 50 is a huge plus for everyday wear. I received this product from Clinique for testing and review purposes

avis.titre: Okay sunscreen but not great under makeup
avis.texte: I love almost all the Clinique products I try. However, this sunscreen fell flat for me. The texture is odd and the formula itself is very yellow on my skin. It can help neutralize if that's what you need. This does not wear well under any sort of actual makeup and needs to be heavily set if you wish to do so. Overall, I didn't love this product. I was sent this by Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I love this stuff for my summer days by the pool or doing outdoor activities. It feels so good on my skin. The coverage is very minimal but on a hot summer day by the pool I'm not too worried about my make up. I'm more worried about protecting my skin. This stuff is perfect for it. I'm so happy I have it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I have been using the Clinique brightening + tinted sunscreen. I usually put this on in the am. One of my morning routines. The tin̈ted color matched my skin perfectly. I like the way it feels on my skin and the protection that it provides. I wish the formula was alittle bit thicker. But, overall I would recommend it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I love how lightweight Clinique Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF50 feels on my face. The formula seems to work great with my dry skin, left my face moisturized and protected in one product. Goes on smooth and last all day long. I like wearing just a tinted sunscreen in the summer and not a heavy foundation in the hot days of summer. This will be a must buy for me, perfect for everyday. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Lightweight Daily Sun Protection with Clinique Sunscreen
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I really like the Clinique sunscreen because it feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin. It absorbs easily without leaving a heavy or greasy feeling, making it perfect for everyday use. It provides reliable sun protection while helping my skin feel moisturized and comfortable. I also love that it works well under makeup and fits easily into my daily skincare routine. Overall, it's a great sunscreen for anyone looking for effective sun protection with a smooth, comfortable finish.

Super protective with and added pigment to match your skin tone what more could you ask for to add to your summer skincare routine I have received this as a sample from Topbox Circle and I definitely recommend it

I really like Clinique UV Solutions Brightening + Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50/PA+++. It blends smoothly, feels lightweight, and gives my skin a natural, even-toned finish without looking heavy. The sun protection is excellent, and it wears comfortably throughout the day. It's become a reliable part of my daily skincare routine.

I received this brightening tint for free to test and review. Overall, I did like the skin tint because it was almost a perfect match for my complexion. I applied it in the morning after cleaning my face, and it gave my skin a clear, dewy look. I also didn't notice any unattractive scent. The only thing I didn't care for was that on extremely hot days when I would sweat a lot, the tint was noticeable as it would start to bead up on my skin. Aside from that, I would definitely recommend this product.

This is such a great product for the summer time. It's nice to have as a backup but probably wouldn't be my go-to. I like how lightweight it is but I feel like the texture doesn't make it long lasting. I have very dry skin so it just doesn't age well on my face. I still really like the product and plan on using it for those short days like running errands or hanging with friends for a bit. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Clinique is one of my favorite brands. It is tried and true and I've been using it for decades. I love a tinted sunscreen because I don't always wanna wear foundation and I just want my freckles to shine through. Tinted sunscreen is perfect because I get my glow skin and protection from the sun for my fair complexion while not completely covering up my natural look I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I thought this product had great wear. The coverage was to me was very buildable and was light to medium coverage. I liked how easy it was to blend and it worked well on my acne prone skin. It was slightly oily while I already had oily skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This tinted sunscreen is natural on me, like it just evens my skin out without looking like I'm actually wearing makeup. It's not greasy on me, and doesn't cling to my dry spots which is a big deal for me. Some tinted SPFs can get weird and patchy, but this one blends in really easy and just melts into my skin. The brightening part is subtle, not sparkly or anything, just a nice glow. The coverage is light, so I still go in with a little concealer if I need it, but for everyday errands etc, this is perfect.

avis.titre: Smells bad, too much pigment, needs lighter coverage
avis.texte: Great, but use sparingly because the tinted pigment is really strong. Tinted sunscreen should be a minimal coverage in terms of pigment for the tint, and more sunscreen-ish. The fact that the sunscreen is very pigmented and foundation like makes it sticky to the touch when applied in the summer, and it doesn't feel very natural. Tldr: the tinted sunscreen should be less pigmented / less coverage because thats what foundation is for. The pigment really overrid my natural foundation and made it look too tanned for the time of summer that I am in. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: This is not for me, but you might love it.
avis.texte: ery subtle. Unfortunately, I found this sunscreen to be a little too tacky for my taste. My skin is not super sensitive, but it broke out after using this product. This sunscreen has the makings of a perfect product, which is why I'm so disappointed that it's too tacky and thick for me to continue using.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I enjoyed using it as it felt like a good color match for me, has high UV protection, and applies relatively easily. My one gripe is it got a bit slippery on sweatier hot days. Overall would recommend!

Tinted sunscreens are a must for me in the summer and this one didn't disappoint! The Clinique tinted sunscreen gives my skin a effortless tint while providing great protection. I typically find problems with finding tints that are spf 50 and aren't too thick, but this product is a very thin consistency that absorbs right into my skin. It blends easily and has a natural finish. I always look for products that won't pill and I'm satisfied that this one doesn't. I didn't notice any strong smell and but my skin will feel greasy if I don't use powder. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

've been using the Clinique Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50, and it's quickly become one of my favorite daily SPF products. The lightweight formula blends effortlessly into my skin, and the sheer tint helps even out my complexion without feeling heavy or looking cakey. It gives my skin a healthy, natural-looking glow while still feeling breathable throughout the day. I also love that it provides broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection while helping my skin look brighter over time. It layers beautifully under makeup without pilling and doesn't leave a greasy finish. If you're looking for an everyday sunscreen that offers high sun protection with a subtle skin-enhancing tint, this is definitely worth trying.

avis.titre: Perfect for an everyday natural glow
avis.texte: I've been using Clinique's CC Cream for years, so I was excited to try this tinted sunscreen. It's lightly scented and a little goes a long way. The formula is fairly thick, so I find it applies best over my moisturizer, which helps it spread more evenly. I also like to dust a little setting powder over my T-zone to cut down on shine. I love that it's tinted because I don't wear much makeup. It gives just enough coverage to even out my skin tone while leaving a soft, healthy glow without feeling heavy. Best of all, it doesn't break me out. The added SPF is a huge bonus and makes it especially practical for summer. Overall, it's a great option for anyone looking for lightweight coverage with everyday sun protection. [I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.]

After using this sunscreen for awhile, I quite enjoy it. It spreads well, the consistency isn't too thick. It blends with my skin, it takes about tens seconds to rub it in. But there's no white cast after. It doesn't cause tearing eyes and has long-lasting coverage. No noticeable fragrance. One thing to note is there is niacinamide in the ingredients. If you are sensitive, steer away. I received this from Clinique for testing purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I spend a lot of time on the sun over the summer. This tinted sunscreen not only provides a light coverage but also skin protection. The sunscreen goes on smoothly and blends very nicely. It is not a foundation, so the coverage is not the same, which I appreciate on a hot day. Just enough coverage to hide small imperfections and it does not feel heavy.

I wore this to three weddings and it held up for all of them. I love the thinness of this product and the color. It is a little sticky so I wore powder on top. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

Clinique products have always been my life savers and products I always go back to. That's why when I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes I was and still am super excited because it's a brand that's in my mist have items. I love this UV Solutions brightening + tinted SPF 50 it is very easy to use. The consistency in my opinion is very liquidity but it does apply nice and smoothly and I will definitely do better with how much I use. My skin is now protected, ready for my make up and look at this glow

Clinique UV Solutions tinted sunscreen is a light airy sun protection that goes on after skincare, or over makeup. This sunscreen is spf 50, and gives off a nice illuminating sheen to the face. It's formulated with niacinamide, which brightens and strengths skin barrier. So it's skincare and skin protection all in one. I love that it's formulated from mineral. The tinted sunscreen comes in different shades, I received deep for my complexion. This sunscreen leaves my skin feeling soft, and looking luminous all day long. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is a pretty good tinted sunscreen. I love that it has SPF 50. I feel like that's the bare minimum you need on your face. I will say that I wish there was a wider color palette. The lightest shade is really too dark for me. The good thing is, since it is very sheer, it does not make me look orange. I usually mix it with a moisturizer to make it even more sheer. It definitely does what it says, which is keep you from getting sunburned and protects you from the sun's harmful rays. I've been using it for about a month and there is still plenty left. I can't speak to its brightening claims since it hasn't been that long. But it definitely has made my skin feel a bit smoother. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been impressed with Clinique Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 in the Medium shade. The formula feels lightweight, blends easily, and provides reliable sun protection while giving my skin a healthy, natural-looking tint. It evens out my complexion without feeling heavy like a foundation, making it perfect for everyday wear. The finish is comfortable and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy, and I appreciate that it layers well under makeup or can be worn on its own. The only downside is that the tint may not be a perfect match for every skin tone. Overall, it's a great option if you're looking for high SPF protection with light coverage and a radiant, natural finish. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Love this product. I exclusively use tinted sunscreen as I have melasma on my face, and tinted sunscreen is the best option to further protect my skin from dark spots. The Clinique Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen goes on smooth and blends in really well, without leaving any cast. I love that it has SPF 50 so it gives good sun coverage. I put it on in the morning and reapply around noon. I will continue to buy this product moving forward. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Glowy skin and loved for no make up days
avis.texte: For the last months I have been testing out Clinique UV solutions brightening and tinted spf 50 tinted mineral sunscreen in the shade medium. I have to say the coverage is wonderful with this if you're looking for something illuminating and natural. I will say however it can be very glowy so for those who don't like the glazed donut look all you need is a good setting powder and mattifying setting spray and you're good to go! The formula is easy to apply, did not break me out formulated with niacinamide skincare and fragrance free. I highly recommend it on those no make up make up days where you just want your skin to look a little bit more alive. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Excellent tinted sunscreen for daily use. It applies smoothly, doesn't feel greasy, and leaves a natural finish. The SPF 50 protection is great, and the niacinamide helps brighten my skin over time. Perfect for days when I want light coverage without wearing foundation. Would buy again.

I've been using this mostly by itself but it also works good for me as a primer. It doesn't have a sticky feel to it and was easy to blend out. It has a natural finish and does a good job of evening out my skin tone. I recommend it! The brightening aspect is a plus too! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Not for those with oily skin
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I really wanted to like this sunscreen but the undertone is very warm and noticeable on my light medium neutral undertone skin. It also moved around on my face all day long. I wear a mask at work and found that this smudged off all over the inside of the mask and then left my face very patchy afterwards.

This product worked amazing. The sunscreen was an amazing shade for my skin. It looks like makeup. It's gentle and has no smell. I applied it first thing in the morning. It had no grit to it at all. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Sun protection and natural coverage in a single step.
avis.texte: I really liked this tinted sunscreen. It feels lightweight, blends easily, and leaves a very natural finish without looking heavy. In addition to providing good sun protection with SPF 50, it helps even out skin tone and lasts for several hours. I would definitely buy it again.

I always put on sunscreen as the last step in my morning skincare and thought it would be nice to try one that is illuminating. It has a nice emollient texture that didn't pill under my primer, although it took a few minutes for the initial shine to go down. I noticed that the protective factor is enough for my skin and I didn't have redness at the end of the day. It's a bit too illuminating for my skin but I'm on the very oily side. It would probably be a great fit for normal to dry skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I am impressed with this new product from Clinique! Their Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen is broad spectrum and is an impressive SPF 50. I used it as a base layer when going out for a fun day with friends, but since it's tinted it's just as good on its own as a light foundation for days in the garden or running errands. I liked that it wasn't scented, and didn't feel greasy or sticky at all. [I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.]

I love a good tinted sunscreen, but this product was a lot thinner than I anticipated and once it was on, you couldn't really see a tint. The sunscreen did it's job, even held up well while sweating in this southern heat, but after applying in the morning before my makeup, it left me shiny and left me feeling oily. Overall, I think I would stick with just a regular sunscreen under my makeup. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

"I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes" I really wanted to love this product because I'm usually a huge fan of Clinique, but sadly, that wasn't the case. I'm all about spf in my foundation or skin tints, but I found this formula so heavy and pore clogging. Like the sweat felt trapped and it caused large breakouts for me, which is the opposite of what I want during the summer.

avis.titre: A sunscreen that doesn't feel like sunscreen
avis.texte: I've been loving this tinted SPF. It absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and doesn't leave a white cast. The tint gives my skin a more even look, so I can skip foundation when I want a more natural makeup day. I also have sensitive skin, and it's been working really well for me. I'm wearing 01 Light. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I love me a tinted sunscreen, and am a big fan of Clinique's complexion products. Honestly this is really perfect for me, especially with the trips I ahve planned that are coming up. I hate going on a cruise and putting on a full face for dinner when I want something lightweight, so this tinted sunscreen is the golden product for me. It's lightweight, and all I need in addition to it is some concealer and mascara. I also really love the high SPF, since I feel like other tinted sunscreens I've tried cap out at 30. I'll definitely be getting another tube when this one runs out. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been looking for a mineral sunscreen that feels comfortable enough to wear every day, and this one exceeded my expectations. The texture is smooth and easy to blend, and the tinted formula helps even out my complexion without feeling heavy. It leaves my skin looking fresh with a natural finish and works well under makeup without pilling. I also appreciate that it provides SPF 50 protection while keeping my skin hydrated throughout the day. It feels gentle, doesn't irritate my skin, and has become an easy step in my morning routine. Overall, I'm very happy with this sunscreen and would gladly continue using it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. This has become one of my favorite daily sunscreens. It feels lightweight, blends in smoothly, and the tint gives my skin a more even, radiant look without feeling like foundation. It doesn't leave my skin greasy and wears nicely throughout the day, even under makeup. The SPF 50 protection is a great bonus, and I'd happily keep using it.

avis.titre: Tinted Sunscreen gives a Healthy Lightweight Glow
avis.texte: I've been using the Clinique Brightening+Tinted 100% Mineral Sunscreen in Medium and it is such an awesome product! My skin has an actual glow to it and it looks healthy, natural, and soft. It is very lightweight and I didn't notice an odor at all. I love that it has an SPF 50 because I know that I'm taking care of my skin! Such a great product! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Blends well and no white cast!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is AMAZING. I love the light weight liquid texture, it blends so well into my skin and the best part is no white cast! I'll be honest at first I was a little intimidated by the shade of this sunscreen, but it looks so pretty and glowy once you apply it. I feel like it adds a nice natural dewy look. Overall, I'm very impressed! Definitely worth it. *I received this product from Clinique in exchange for my honest feedback

I've been using this sunscreen for a few days now and I'm really impressed. It blends in beautifully without leaving a white cast, and the tinted formula gives my skin a nice, even look while still feeling lightweight. I love that it provides SPF 50 protection without feeling greasy or heavy throughout the day. It wears well under makeup and keeps my skin looking fresh. Overall, it's a great everyday sunscreen that I can see myself reaching for regularly. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I've finally found a tinted spf that actually matches my skin tone and doesn't melt off after an hour! I love how this feels on my skin and it lasts ALL day which is perfect for me! *I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes*

I like the tinted SPF from Clinique, I have the light shade and the coverage is light, but it's enough to even out my skin tone. It blends pretty well and feels comfortable and not greasy. It works when I want sun protection with a little coverage. Using the recommended amount of a 1/4 teaspoon to get adequate SPF protection, it does take a bit to blend in, but overall it works. I love the skincare ingredients to keep skin hydrated and even more protected. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been trying this Clinique UV Solutions brightening & tinted SPF50 for a little over two weeks now and I have mixed opinions. (To note I have normal to dry skin) I really like the texture and consistency of the product, it's very thin and almost liquidy but I think that is why it applies so well without streaks and it has a good amount of slip to it, so it doesn't settle into any of my fine lines. I've applied it using a brush, sponge & with my fingers like I would a moisturizer and all have worked. It's great for days when I don't have a lot of time but I still want to wear something. The finish is more of a luminous satin, it gives a healthy glow (with no shimmer or glitter) but if you have oily skin it may be too glowy for you. Where I have the mixed feelings is when it comes to the tint & coverage. I have shade light and while it doesn't make me look pale or washed out, I really don't see much coverage at all. It may even out my skin the tiniest bit but it's not something that will cover blemishes, redness or dark spots. It's perfect for the 'no makeup' look. The SPF hasn't clogged my pores or made me break out and it easily breaks down/washes off without leaving a residue behind. There is no white or gray undertones like some mineral tinted SPF has. It doesn't feel greasy or heavy and really does give a nice glow. I just wish it had at least a little more pigment and coverage. **I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This spf is perfect for the summer if you have dry skin. I use it on top of my primer before i put on my foundation for protection for face knack and shoulder . It mixes well with my other products i put on my face. I will say it does leave my face dewy but i dont find. it gives you lights yto medium coverage. All i need was concealer.

avis.titre: Great Lightweight Mineral Sunscreen for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I have sensitive combination skin and this tinted sunscreen worked really well for me. It didn't irritate my skin at all and it's lightweight and comfortable to wear. I got the Medium shade and it blends in easily. It does provide a natural finish with subtle glow. I love that it's a 100% mineral sunscreen with SPF 50 so I know I'm getting good UVA and UVB protection. It also has niacinamide and antioxidants, which are nice skincare extras. It absorbs well and doesn't leave my skin greasy. I also like that it's fragrance-free and doesn't contain most of the ingredients I usually try to avoid. Overall, it's a great sunscreen for everyday wear and it layers well under my makeup too.

I received this product from Clinique for free for testing and review purposes. I use this every morning, after washing my face and doing my skin care routine. It blends nicely and leaves a little glow to the skin. I have acne prone skin, so I was a bit worried at first. So far I have not gotten any breakouts and I've been using this product for a few weeks now. This is definitely a keeper!

This is so lightweight and glowy. It's perfect for the summer! The only thing that I will note is to go up a shade if you ran easily. I got the light shade when I wasn't tan, and I tanned up super fast and it no longer matches my skin as well. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is so good as a daily use product. It has a thick moisturizing texture and has light coverage that can act as a primer for foundation if needed. At minimum I use this with a lip oil daily. I live in a humid climate and the sunscreen stayed on throughout the day and even through a light workout. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Overall this is a great product. It covers the skin well and leaves a shine behind. It is definitely a thicker consistency than their other formula. I didn't notice much of a smell but I do like to set it with a translucent powder afterwards to get less transfer. It has light coverage that evens out my skin tone. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

So I got lucky and got this product right before I went to the beach. Now when I tell y'all that I tan insanely easily. I used this product all days and my only gripe with it is the packaging. It does leak a bit but other than that the finish is beautiful and the formula was very lightweight and hydrating. I definitely recommend it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. Good product felt light on my skin and had great coverage for hot weather. SPF worked well

I love this facial sunscreen. I apply it most mornings under my makeup but the tint on it is so lovely sometimes I don't even put any foundation on. I live at 5100 feet so the sun can be really problematic and age us faster than we want around here. I love the feel of this on my skin, its mot greasy or heavy. Also doesnt stink. Highly recommend this facial sunscreen! I did recieve this for free for testing purposes but my thoughts are genuine!

I used this sunscreen in the morning as the last step in my skincare routine and really liked how lightweight and thin it felt on my skin. It blended in easily without feeling heavy or greasy, making it a great option for hot summer days. The tinted shade was also a good match for my skin tone and gave me a natural, even-looking finish. I would definitely continue using this for everyday sun protection. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
Works amazingly! I use it every day and you can automatically see the difference. My skin is getting clearer and makes my skins glow!

I've been using this sunscreen every morning as the last step in my skincare routine, and it's been a great addition. The texture is lightweight, smooth, and blends into my skin without feeling greasy or heavy. I really like the tinted formula because it helps even out my complexion and gives my skin a natural, healthy-looking glow. It wears well under makeup and provides SPF 50 protection, which makes me feel confident wearing it every day. I also appreciate that it feels comfortable throughout the day and doesn't dry out my skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using this Clinique UV Solutions SPF 50 and I am honestly so impressed. I loved using it! It has a very gentle formula that didn't break me out or cause any redness whatsoever, which is a huge win for my skin the light tint shade gives me a subtle glow.

I really love this product this silky, tinted sunscreen leaves a soft, glowing finish, it visibly brightens and reduces fine lines and dark spots, helps protect against damaging UV rays with 100% mineral sunscreen filters and premature signs of aging with antioxidants, I highly recommend this product.

As someone with combination, acne-prone skin, I was skeptical that this would work for me but it did! I live in AZ, so sun protection is crucial. A thin layer of this evened out my skin without making it look greasy and I didn't break out. Definitely recommend! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I really wanted to love it but all it did was make me super glowy/oily and gave me no actual tint or coloring. I ended up using it under my makeup as a moisturizer and just putting skin tint/ foundation over it. Also I do have combination skin so this might work better for someone with Dry skin

This is a good tinted sunscreen for the day-to-day when you don't want to wear too much makeup, but still want a little coverage and sun prevention. The coverage is good and it doesn't leave a white cast. It gives a healthy glow, but is more on the matte side and I have dry skin, so I do like more dew in my tinted sunscreen. *I received this product for free from Clinque for testing and reviewing purposes.*

avis.titre: Perfect for my light skin with natural undertone
avis.texte: Now this is my very favorite tinted spf. It's very gentle on skin color of tint amazingly matched with my light skin with natural undertone. I put in before makeup and I love it.

I've been wearing the Clinique UV Solutions tinted sunscreen every day for about a week now and I've got to say that I'm really pleased with it. I'm fair-skinned and the color blends in with my natural tone very well and the formula is very light and not at all greasy. The only thing I dislike about it is that it felt a little drying at times, but that wasn't too big of a deal and I'm sure some people with oilier skin might appreciate that. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: No shiny, No greasy, even in the heat!
avis.texte: I love this tinted sunscreen! I have light to medium skin with an olive undertone and used the color, medium. When I first looked at it, I was worried it was going to be too dark and cast to orange, but it was surprisingly pretty perfect! It is sheer and lightweight, so it is not leaving a ton of heavy color sitting on your skin, I think making it more versatile for different skin tones. Also, because it is a thinner consistency with skin care included in the formula (love) it glides on and melts right into my skin. I tend to lean to dry skin, even in summer, so I LOVE that the tint does not stick to any dry spots. In fact it really gave my skin a moisturized glow. I do not like wearing foundation in the summer and this has made it possible. I have been out in the heat and sun (and it has been HOT here this year) and experienced zero melt or color issues even when sweating. It just makes my skin have such a nice, even, and I think brighter glow to it. Summer make up can be really tough, especially trying to find a sunscreen that plays nice with other products. If you need heavier foundation coverage this will probably be too sheer, but if you are looking to just even out your complexion and protect your skin you will love it. I could not be happier that I found a one step product that actually looks great! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been really happy with this SPF. It protected my skin well—I accidentally forgot to apply it to my nose before spending time outside, and my nose was the only place that ended up sunburned. That definitely convinced me it works! The formula has no noticeable scent, which I appreciate, and it feels comfortable on my skin. It does seem like you need to use quite a bit to cover your face, but somehow the small bottle just keeps lasting much longer than I expected. A little bottle really does go a long way. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I've been really impressed with the Clinique UV Solutions Brightening+tinted sunscreen broad spectrum SPF50. The formula is lightweight, blend easily, and gives my skin a healthy, natural glow without feeling greasy or heavy. I love that it's a 100% mineral sunscreen with SPF 50, so I get excellent sun protection while also evening out my complexion with the sheer tint. It lays beautifully under makeup and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or eyes. The addition of niacinamide and antioxidants is a huge bonus, helping my skin look brighter over time while protecting it from daily environmental damage. If you're looking for a sunscreen that feels more like skincare than sunscreen, this is definitely worth trying. The only downside is the price, but a little goes a long way, and the quality makes it feel like a worthwhile investment.

avis.titre: Very lightweight, very radiant on my skin.
avis.texte: This was a very lightweight, non-sticky SPF. It felt great on my skin. I also like the luminosity left. I love that. It was an SPF 50. That is so hard to get in a great skin care line. This is really the first skincare tint that lasted all day on my skin. Thank you, Clinique for making a great skin care with a high SPF. I've been looking for this for a very long time. I have dry yet combo skin, and I struggle with finding this. This will be my new go to for all seasons. I have recommended this too many of my friends. I just recently went to my dermatologist and she said how great my skin looks and that she was happy that I continue to use SPF. I did tell her about the skin tint and she was very happy about it and said that she was going to start using it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Really Enjoy and Easy to Use
avis.texte: I really enjoy this and have been using it a few times a week in the mornings before work! very easy to apply - I just use my fingers! Blends seamlessly for a slight glow and love that it has spf! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This was my first sunscreen tint. I really enjoyed it as it did not feel heavy on my skin like makeup would. It gave my skin a boost of confidence and glow while providing SPF protection. I was afraid the color was too dark for my skin, but it ended up looking more wearable after trying it out. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: New contender in the tinted sunscreen game!
avis.texte: First, let me say I was super excited to try this as tinted sunscreens have definitely been my go to lately. The consistency was a little runny, but it went on smooth and blended well. I personally found it perfect when topped off with powder to take away a bit of the shine. Used as my go to for a couple of weeks and unfortunately the niacinamide did not agree with my skin. I knew this would most likely be the case and really wish this would stop being included in so many products. If you don't have issues with that, I highly recommend this. I passed this along to my mom (whose skin is much less sensitive) and she absolutely loves it. Her skin absolutely glows with using this alone. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Protection and a beautiful finish in one step
avis.texte: This product has quickly become one of my favorites. I've added it to my morning routine, and I love the way it makes my skin look and feel. The texture is incredibly smooth, blends effortlessly, and doesn't leave a white cast. My skin felt amazing from the very first application, with a natural, even-looking finish. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been loving the Clinique Tinted Sunscreen in the Light shade. It gives my skin a natural, healthy-looking glow while evening out my complexion without feeling heavy. The lightweight formula blends effortlessly, feels comfortable all day, and doesn't leave my skin greasy. It's perfect for those no-makeup makeup days when I want light coverage with the added benefit of sun protection. If you like a natural, fresh finish that lets your skin breathe, this one is definitely worth trying! & I was gifted by Clinique for test purpos

This is my first time trying a tinted sunscreen and love it. It was so easy to apply to my skin and was so easy to smooth and didn't leave no streaks. It is the perfect shade for my complexion and will continue to use. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

The product did its job of being a sheer brightening tint.For me I dislike the sheer look. The color was another issue I had. I dislike how there isn't that many shade to chose from. I would have to get two in order to fully match. Also I have oily skin so this made it even more noticeable. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

The shade medium was perfect for me. There was no white cast, it blended into the skin really well. Gave a really nice finish and some coverage as well. Overall really liked using it. I received this product free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I was so excited to try it, and it did not disappoint! The shade matched my skin perfectly and blended seamlessly, providing just the right amount of coverage especially since It's a tinted sunscreen. I applied it right after my skincare routine, and it layered amazing under my makeup without causing any issues. It felt lightweight and comfortable on my skin all day, and it didn't leave me looking oily. I was so happy to receive this product. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This lightweight tinted sunscreen is perfect for summer. I use it daily, its so easy to apply. I put a few drops on my face and use my fingers to spread it around my face. I also love that it is brightening, just adds a little something to the skin. Seriously I love it and you should try it! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Loved The Tint, Not The Finish
avis.texte: I'm a 55-year-old Black woman with combination skin, a light-to-medium brown complexion with warm undertones, and a consistent, detailed skincare routine — so I know how a product should layer. The shade match here is genuinely excellent, blending with no cast. My issue is the texture: it's very thick and leaves a shiny finish that never settled, even under powder foundation and finishing powder. I wanted to love the SPF 50 protection, but the heavy feel keeps this at 3 out of 5 stars. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using Clinique's Brightening Tinted mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 every day for the past few weeks which is more like a true skin tint rather than a tinted sunscreen IMO The formula is very thin and lightweight, so it spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and never feels heavy on my skin. With SPF 50, it provides excellent sun protection, and even on hot, humid days when I'm sweating, it stays in place instead of sliding off. Best of all, it doesn't leave a white cast or oxidize throughout the day. It had no sunscreen scent, no scent at all. It contains niacinamide, which leaves my skin feeling hydrated, and I've noticed my skin feels softer and more moisturized since I started using it. The tint provides a light to medium coverage that helps even out my complexion and gives my skin a healthy dewy glow which is perfect for no makeup days or when I just want a little extra color. It also layers beautifully under powder without looking cakey. One thing I would note is the shade selection. My skin tone is usually light to medium, but I found the Medium shade to be a bit too dark for me. If you're between light and medium like I am, I'd recommend choosing one shade lighter. As someone with sensitive skin, I'm also happy to report that it hasn't caused any breakouts. Overall, i do really like this product and will be continuing to use it but in a lighter shade. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I liked the product overall but it did leave a bit of an oily feel on the skin. I liked how light coverage and glowy it was. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I am a big fan of tinted sunscreens and absolutely loved this one! It is a runny liquid formula, which I liked because it was very easy to apply so it did not feel like I was wasting product. It blended into my skin nicely and had a very natural finish when applied. The tint helped reduce the look redness and make my complexion look more even. It felt hydrating did not have any cast or streaky look like many sunscreens do. I used this in the morning before applying the rest of my makeup, and my makeup went on very smoothly. I use a mix of cream and powder products, and all of them sat nicely on top of the sunscreen and stayed on even better than usual. The product honestly doubled as sunscreen and primer for me, which I loved. This is definitely my favorite tinted sunscreen I have tried! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I typically end up getting a color that is too dark for my skin, but due to the minimal shade options this time I end with a product that was lighter than my skin color. Blends nicely just makes my face look pale. Feels light weight. No harsh smell or breakout from the product. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This tinted sunscreen from Clinique isn't bad, but it's not my favorite either. I love tinted sunscreens, as I love that they provide protection while also covering up imperfections. They're never going to achieve the same look as a foundation, but they're great for providing subtle coverage that helps to even skin tone. This particular tinted sunscreen does to that fairly well. It's a lightweight coverage, but enough to cover up some redness and pimples. I got it in the color light, which is a decent shade match for me, but I find that it pulls too far orange for my liking. I need to mix it with other products to get the right tone and color. I also have fairly oily skin and this gives me a heavy sheen that I don't really love. However, I can top it with powder and that helps to mattify the shine. Overall, it's a decent tinted sunscreen, but I'd like it better if it were less orange and less shiny. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
I love this because i don't have to add extra layer it is tinted so good for daily soft glam and the brand we can trust i got this from clinique for free for testing purposes.
I use this product in morning , i like it it very light its give me a bright shade and glowy skin

Very simple for everyday use. I just apply it with my hands every morning, and it stays looking natural the whole day. I have sensitive skin, but this doesn't break me out. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Lightweight Protection With a Brightening Boost
avis.texte: I've been using this product in the morning as the last step in my skincare routine, and I really like how it feels on my skin. It goes on smoothly, blends easily, and doesn't leave any heavy or greasy residue. The texture is lightweight but still gives me that brightened, even look I want before makeup. I also appreciate that the tint isn't overwhelming — it just adds a soft, natural finish. The scent is very subtle, which I prefer, and it didn't irritate my skin at all. Overall, it's a great everyday SPF with a little extra glow. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. The UV solutions brightening+tinted sunscreen has been the last step of my skincare routine for the past few weeks. I love how my skin looks after applying it. My skin tone is more even and my skin looks brighter and hydrated. I only have to add some lip gloss maskara and I'm ready for the day plus my skin is protected from the sun It is super lightweight.

This is the perfect combination of skincare and sun protection. The tint is natural and helps blur minor imperfections while keeping my skin hydrated all day. It doesn't clog my pores or leave a white cast. Highly recommend for everyday wear!

I have been using this since 3 weeks now. The formula is very lightweight and is non greasy, non sticky. The ingredients are clean and non toxic, it feels like a serum on my face. It does not have a white cast. I tend to sweat a lot so I apply powder after it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been really impressed with this sunscreen. The formula is incredibly lightweight and doesn't leave that thick, greasy feeling that so many sunscreens have. Once it's on, I hardly notice I'm wearing it, which makes it easy to use every day.It also gives my skin a beautiful, natural-looking glow while helping to tone down some of my redness, so I find myself using less makeup. The SPF 50 is another huge plus because I know my skin is getting excellent sun protection while still looking fresh and radiant. I received this product for free from Topbox Circle and Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Glowy, sheer coverage and skin protection
avis.texte: I'm all about a BB cream, but this product has a bit less coverage than I had hoped for. What it lacks in pigment it makes up for with a glowy, dewy finish. It feels a bit thick like sunscreen and has a bit of that stereotypical smell, but I don't mind. I can put it on in the morning or before work and it does last better than other products I've tried. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really like this tinted sunscreen. I think it did great seamlessly melting into my skin. I love that it has spf to keep me protected from the summer heat. I would recommend this to any of my friends! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
This sunscreen blends in really well with my skin tone, however, as someone with really oily skin this makes me really shiny.
This tinted sunscreen is a game changer! I use it in the morning after I shower, easy to apply and blend in with no sunscreen smell. The best 1 step easy routine to work it! My new favorite!

avis.titre: Perfecting facial tinted sunscreen-dry skin approved!
avis.texte: So, I've been using UV Solutions Brightening + Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 in shade light for about 3 weeks. It's easy to apply and there's no visible white swirls afterward. This sunscreen wears well, keeps my dry skin perfectly plumped and with an illuminated tint that matches my skintone perfectly. The performance I would rate 5 stars after taking my kids for the entire day to our local waterpark! My only issue is that it took a makeup remover balm (Clinique Take the Day Off) to completely remove a mineral sunscreen. While I already had this on hand and I'm not complaining about it's staying power at all, it just seemed harder to remove than others. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is a nice product to have for summer when you want just a bit of coverage, but more so sun protection. I found this to be quite a good dupe of a similar product from a popular sunscreen brand, with the exception that this one is a bit runnier. It definitely applies best with either a foundation brush or a sponge. It can look a tad oily so I liked to apply a little setting powder on top.

avis.titre: Love how this SPF 50 brightens my skin
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I received this product to try out and I loved it—l use the "medium deep" shade. I love how it absorbs into my skin and doesn't feel sticky, and I can even reapply my SPF without it feeling cakey.

I've been really impressed with this tinted sunscreen. The formula is lightweight and blends easily into my skin without feeling heavy or greasy. It provides SPF 50 protection while giving my complexion a healthy, natural-looking glow and just enough tint to even out my skin tone. It is very sheer & doesn't feel like I'm wearing makeup, making it perfect for everyday use. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free and gentle on my skin. It layers well under makeup without pilling, but it also looks great on its own for a fresh, no-makeup look. The only thing to keep in mind is that the formula is quite fluid, so be careful when dispensing it. Overall, it's a fantastic daily sunscreen that combines sun protection with a subtle brightening effect, and I'll definitely continue reaching for it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I loved the color on this and how effortlessly and smoothly it blended with no greasy cast or feeling on my skin. It gave me a healthy glow and felt moisturizing. The smell was subtle and pleasant The coverage was perfect. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I'm a sunscreen person all year long and I'm also in my early 50s and I don't think I've used anything by this brand since I was much younger. So when they recommended, I give it a try after trying so many other tinted sunscreens that had really crappy coverage I was skeptical. First time I use this I was really impressed by how well it created an even tone get glow to my skin without looking too shiny and without looking too much but even more so I was out in the sun all day long without a hat, and I did not get sunburnt so I know this is really good product. And I'm happy to say Clinique is now back in my routine and on my radar.

This is an essential item for summer. I love how easy it is to blend, it feels light on my skin and still enough for protection. The tinted color helps to cover some acne marks so I don't even need to wear make up. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using this for a while and I'm really happy with it. It goes on smoothly, feels lightweight, and gives my skin a nice natural glow without feeling oily. I also like that it has SPF 50, so I know my skin is protected every day. The tint is subtle and helps even out my skin tone

I've been really impressed with Clinique Brightening & Tinting Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50. It provides excellent sun protection while giving my skin a healthy, natural-looking glow. The lightweight formula blends in easily, evens out my complexion without feeling heavy, and doesn't leave a greasy or sticky finish. I also appreciate that it feels comfortable enough for everyday wear and works well under makeup. My skin looks brighter and more even, and the tinted finish helps minimize the appearance of minor imperfections without looking like foundation. If you're looking for a daily sunscreen that combines high SPF protection with a subtle, radiant tint, this is definitely worth trying. I received this product from Clinique free for testing purposes.

avis.titre: Added sun protection and glowy results
avis.texte: The Clinique brightening + tinted illuminator sunscreen is just that, brightening and illuminating. At first I applied this on its own and thought "Oh no, there's no way I can pull this off" as it was so glowy I looked like I went hard with the highlighter, however reading is fundamental lol. This goes under your foundation, it is not meant to be a stand alone product. Under my makeup it worked rather well, there was no creasing or breaking up of my foundation and it indeed added an extra glow. I'm thankful for the added sun protection as well. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Long Lasting Protection and Smells Great!!
avis.texte: I received this product in return for an honest review. I have very light skin that burns easily. Unique UV solutions gave me protection for my face and gave that little extra OOMPH some of us need before heading out. The product is not greasy, goes on smoothly, and has a satisfying scent. I absolutely loved this product, and I will keep using it.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I really like Clinique's Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50. The product is lightweight, blends easily, doesn't feel greasy or heavy. This is perfect for me, since I do a lot of yard work and work in a hot factory. I love that it helps even out my complexion, gives my skin a healthy and natural look, all while still feeling hydrated!

avis.titre: Nice tinted sunscreen for everyday use
avis.texte: I use this UV solutions brightening and tinted sunscreen with broad spectrum SPF 50 everyday. I am using shade medium, it's very lightweight and doesn't leave any white cast. Blends so well in my skin. Giving that nice light coverage and even skin tone. Skin feels soft and protects from sun damage. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This brightening and tint spf 50 is perfect for those sunny days. I wore this at an event and the uv rays were extremely high that day. It blending perfectly while protecting my skin. The scent isnt over baring. No white cast of course, and the color matches perfectly to my skin tone

Clinique Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 is a great option for anyone looking to combine sun protection with light complexion-enhancing coverage. The tinted formula blends well into the skin, helping to even out skin tone while minimizing the white cast that many mineral sunscreens leave behind.

I've been using this tinted sunscreen as part of my morning routine, and I liked how lightweight and comfortable it felt on my skin. The texture blended in easily without feeling heavy or greasy, and I appreciated that it didn't wear like a foundation. Instead, it gave my skin a subtle tint that helped even out my complexion while still looking natural. The scent was light and not overpowering, which I also enjoyed. While I was hoping for just a bit more coverage, I think it's a great option for anyone looking for everyday sun protection with a natural, "your skin but better" finish rather than makeup. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Lightweight Mineral SPF That Brightens Beautifully
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I've been very impressed with this tinted mineral sunscreen. It blends much more smoothly than many mineral SPFs I've tried and leaves my skin looking healthy, even-toned, and naturally radiant instead of chalky or overly shiny. The lightweight texture feels comfortable throughout the day and doesn't leave my face feeling heavy or greasy. The SPF 50 protection gives me confidence when I'm outdoors, and I appreciate that it also contains niacinamide and antioxidants to support my skincare routine. The subtle tint helps minimize redness and gives my complexion a fresh, polished appearance, making it a great option for days when I want light coverage without wearing foundation. Overall, this is an excellent daily sunscreen that combines effective sun protection with skincare benefits and a flattering finish. I'll definitely continue reaching for it as part of my morning routine.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I really like this product! It feels super lightweight on the skin, which is exactly what I was looking for. It also gives me just enough of a tinted color to look put together. It's definitely perfect for any time of day. The only downside is that the product comes out of the tube pretty quickly, as you can tell, so you end up using more than you bargained for.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I've been really impressed with Clinique's Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50. The formula feels lightweight, blends easily into my skin, and provides reliable sun protection without feeling greasy or heavy. I love that the subtle tint helps even out my complexion while giving my skin a healthy, natural-looking glow instead of leaving a white cast. After wearing it throughout the day, my skin still feels comfortable and hydrated, and it layers beautifully under makeup without pilling. It's become an easy addition to my morning routine because it combines skincare benefits with broad-spectrum SPF protection. If you're looking for a sunscreen that offers light coverage, a radiant finish, and everyday sun protection, this is definitely worth trying.
